column1: # SmartKey English Shorthand Auto-Expansions (shorthand_en.tsv) — v1.1 frequency trim
# Format: trigger<TAB>expansion  — one entry per line, UTF-8, LF line endings.
# Lines starting with '#' are comments. Parsing rule: first TAB splits columns.
# Curation: trigger is never a standalone English word (Rule 1) and has ONE
# unambiguous expansion covering >90% of everyday typing (Rule 2).
# v1.1: trimmed to high-frequency triggers only. Low-frequency/variant triggers
# live in shorthand_en_extended.tsv (opt-in); intentional dev shorthands
# Casing policy: expansions use lowercase except "I" and proper nouns;
# ALL-CAPS input never auto-expands (protects BC, GM, JW, FAQ...).
